[To the [Rev. J. F. W.

Bullock](../persons.html#221)]wold is the termination[.] Canon Benham’s Diocesan Chronicle calls him Athelwold[^2]

C M Yonge

[^1]: Postcard addressed to ‘Revd JFW Bullock/ Radwinter Rectory/ Saffron Walden/ Essex.’ Postmark JA 4/95.

[^2]: This answer presumably relates to a query posed by Bullock in connection with his Daily Lections, to which CMY was contributing some of the [\'Biographies of Eminent Anglicans\'](../books.html#358).
